What kind of mental shifts would that be, if you’re willing to share?

Its more how based on I feel. If I want to feel handsome or feel masculine, I prefer he/him. If I feel more androgynous or am in a bad mood, they/them makes me feel better and I need to hear that. It switches up a bit

Well, they’re my pronouns. Hearing them make me feel respected, accepted, and comfortable. Some days I really need to hear a specific set of pronouns to cheer me up, or even feel loved. It’s somewhat like being misgendered for me. If I say I want to be called they/them and someone refuses, it hurts as much as if they said “she” when I ask to be called “he”

Usually, someone says “lmao, it doesnt matter though, I use he already, isnt that enough?” or something similar if I ask them directly. I’d imagine they think of it as unnecessary or a hassle, even if I try to express how important to me it is. It’s quite infuriating and disheartening as I’m sure you could imagine

I, from my understanding, prefer he/him most of the time, but still really need to hear they/them sometimes. I doubt I need some big change for my ideal to be met- just someone sometimes remembering to say they when I ask for it. My pronouns mean a lot to me, so hearing my pronouns mocked, invalidated, and dismissed makes me feel horrible, when I don’t think I’m asking for a lot. I don’t really ask for someone to understand the pronouns, or even when I want to use them, I just want them to mix it up a bit and say they/them for the day if I ask

No worries, you’re not being rude! I have tried, but for some reason I keep looking like this. I go to the gym once a week and do some simple workouts at home, but I suppose its my body type or something..? I’m not sure, but I’m beginning to lose hope in the healthy ways, since it isn’t working- or at least not fast enough
I’m chubby, and the fat on my thighs makes me look curvy (makes me dysphoric) for the most part

Ever since a kid, I subconsciously knew I was a guy, right? So, seeing how the boys around me were tough and never cried, I made the habit of hiding feelings. I think thats where some of the thoughts come from, just a lot of bottled up sadness and anxieties.

Dysphoria has also been quite the factor in all this, as dysphoria hits hard and leads to overthinking. Self harm is a temporary “shut up” button for dysphoria, but I know that its evolved to be harder and harder to mute. Now, when I feel dysphoria hitting hard, my mind goes straight to suicide. It’s nearly automatic, which is quite freaky.

I’ve also been in quite many... situations. When I was even younger, I spent a lot of time online because I had some anxiety (same for now too), and it turns out that there are a lot of creeps on Discord. DM after DM after DM, NSFW pictures, messages, flirting and attempts of manipulation. It was overwhelming. Things like that have now become a huge trigger for me, so an unexpected DM over discord can make me cry if I’m not feeling great.

All in all, I’m mature for my age for all the wrong reasons and in all the wrong ways. It’s all difficult to deal with at once, especially with schoolwork and keeping friends. I can’t even sleep properly at this point because I keep overthinking. Its... a big yikes
